==About==

With the [[Vegetable Potting]] Skill learned, Green Bell Peppers can be grown by planting other {{i|Green Bell Peppers}}, or a {{i|New World Gourd}} by chance, in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. When planting Green Bell Peppers there is a chance for it to grow into a {{i|Jalapeno}} instead. Planting Bellpeppers in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. Green Bell Peppers can be stored in a {{i|Bellpepper Sack}}.
